messages:
ana: Heads-up — canary in us-west2 (v2.10.4) is showing a p95 latency spike (~+40%) and a small error-rate jump (x3). Not huge but sustained for 3m.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout status: 45% -> 70% in us-west2. Alerts: p95 > 200ms, error_rate > 1.5%. Auto-fallback thresholds not reached (configured 5%).

cheng: I can repro higher tail latency locally when sequence lengths > 1024, KV cache misses spike. Might be an eviction/regression in the cache heuristics from the quant change.

maria: @ana do you want a full revert or a targeted traffic pin for dedicated customers?

ana: typo — @maria @cheng. I think we should avoid a full global revert for now. Plan: graceful degrade in us-west2 only, pin traffic for dedicated/customers on that region back to v2.10.3, and hold hosted canary at 0% until we confirm.

sam_ops: OK executing regional traffic split + pin. Running command: 
```
trafficctl set-split --region us-west2 --from v2.10.4 --to v2.10.3 --percent 100 --reason "latency spike canary"
```

deploy-bot: Executing traffic change: region=us-west2, from=v2.10.4 -> to=v2.10.3, percent=100. Applying...

deploy-bot: Traffic change complete. v2.10.3 now 100% in us-west2. Canary rollout paused.

oncall-bot: Runbook RB-02 (canary regression path) initiated by cheng. Pager duty notified.

leo_engineering: I'll push a quick revert for the KV-cache heuristics to a hotfix branch and run it on staging. ETA ~22m.

cheng: Enabling verbose model-runner logs for affected pods (retain 1h) and turning on per-request kvcache metrics for the region.

maria: I'm drafting communications for support & customers in affected regions. @sam_ops can you forward to customer-success once live? Draft excerpt: "We've rolled back the regional model variant in us-west2 to ensure latency/stability while we investigate a regression introduced in 2.10.4."

sam_ops: Sent to #customer-success and queued the dedicated-customer list. Also pinged contracts team for any SLA concerns.

ana: Monitoring window: keep 100% pinned for 30m. If p95 returns to baseline and error rate normalizes, we'll either re-run a smaller canary with the hotfix or reintroduce incremental traffic.

leo_engineering: Hotfix deployed to staging, running perf test now. If green, I'll cut a canary build for us-west2 with the kv-cache change and run at 10%.

ana: Good. Thanks all. Quick notes: avoid global revert unless customer impact broadens; prefer regional graceful degrade + pin. Document the decision in the release ticket and add steps for future automated fallback tuning. :thumbsup:

cheng: A couple follow-ups I'll add to the ticket: exact sequence-length threshold, cache eviction logs, and histogram of per-request latency.

sam_ops: Closing the thread for exec updates — will post final status once canary small-run completes or we revert further.
